story: Sam wanted to read a storybook inside, but the door was locked. The key was missing. Mum said, “I could help you.” Sam told Mum, “I would like to locate the key.” He fetched the lantern from the porch. Using the lantern, he found the key under the bench. He unlocked the door with the key. He stepped inside the cottage. He hung the key on the hook. Sam opened the storybook beside Mum.
